mathematical_problem.true_coordinate_transport: Cprime_(a,c)=C_(a,c)/lambda_(a,c), for all 18 independent root coordinates, leaves the full connection X and [X_p,X_q] exactly unchanged
mathematical_problem.factorization_invariant_condition: For generic nonzero x_a and Phi_c, Cprime admits source-style shared-Phi rank one iff the 3x6 matrix of inverse phases lambda_(a,c)^(-1) has rank one (all 2x2 minors zero).
